properties.label: Seven measured container rows
properties.text: Compare seven historical page containers as aligned dimension rows, each carrying a name, precise horizontal measure and tabular value; emphasize one chosen specimen in blue.

properties.label: Restrained specification type
properties.text: Use a restrained heading, compact source note and tabular values aligned for quick comparison.

properties.label: White, graphite and drafting blue
properties.text: Use a white sheet, graphite text and one drafting-blue emphasis.

properties.label: Scaled dimension-line comparison
properties.text: Draw fine horizontal measures with endpoint ticks and subtle rulers, using the longest documented chain as the visual scale and labelling any truncated axis.

properties.label: Still scannable measures
properties.text: Keep the measuring view still and scannable.

properties.label: Historical measurement provenance
properties.text: State what was measured and when; treat the values as historical observations rather than current specifications or universal limits.

properties.label: Seven-row mobile acceptance
properties.text: Keep all seven comparisons readable at phone width and make no unsupported claim that one container width or a fixed number of type sizes fits every project.
